purpose: Frozen A per proposal v5.1 §5.1 INV-A-1: per-M acceptance tests. Evaluators return per-candidate raw M scores; the analysis layer (post-lock) computes the four gates G_mod_a..d per evaluator. v4 corrections: actual finalized mutation-dimensions SHA bound (no <filled at freeze>); no 'intra-evaluator rescoring' add-ons.

evaluator_returns: M2_pass (binary: event within +/-30 calendar days of birth date?)
M4_pass (binary: event clearly distinguished from exact-date connections in output text?)
modification_conformance (numeric 0-4: overall M-satisfaction; used for G_mod_a)
candidate_all_pass (derived: M1 AND M2 AND M3 AND M4; used for G_mod_b/G_mod_c/G_mod_d)
evaluator_does_NOT_compute: G_mod_a (requires reconstruction-level mean across all candidates in R; analysis-side only)
G_mod_b (requires Arm-M aggregate candidate count; analysis-side only)
G_mod_c (requires per-reconstruction all-pass rate; analysis-side only)
G_mod_d (requires contemporaneous Arm-C vs Arm-M aggregate; analysis-side only)

G_mod_a.definition: For each evaluator independently: across all Arm-M candidates in the experiment (all reconstructions pooled), the mean of modification_conformance >= 3.5/4.

G_mod_b.definition: For each evaluator independently: >=80% of Arm-M candidates have candidate_all_pass == true (i.e., pass all four M1..M4 checks).
G_mod_b.formula: G_mod_b = (count(candidate_all_pass==True for all Arm-M candidates) / count(total Arm-M candidates) >= 0.80)

G_mod_c.definition: For each evaluator independently: every Arm-M reconstruction has >=70% of its candidates with candidate_all_pass == true (i.e., pass all four M1..M4 checks).
G_mod_c.formula: G_mod_c = AND over R in {R1, R2, R3}: (count(candidate_all_pass==True for Arm-M candidates in R) / count(total Arm-M candidates in R) >= 0.70)

G_mod_d.definition: For each evaluator independently: the Arm-M all-pass rate (across all candidates pooled) exceeds the Arm-C all-pass rate by >=50 percentage points.
G_mod_d.note: This is the contemporaneous Arm-C vs Arm-M comparison per proposal v5.1 §5.2 matched-pair design. Arm-C all-pass rate is computed from the locked Arm-C scorebooks; Arm-M all-pass rate from the locked Arm-M scorebooks. The analysis layer computes both from the four locked scorebooks.

modification_success_aggregation_rule.formula: Modification_Success_per_evaluator = G_mod_a AND G_mod_b AND G_mod_c AND G_mod_d (per proposal v5.1 §5.4 STEP 1)

blinded_artifacts: Evaluator A and B receive only the candidate output + evaluator input packet (no arm identity, no reconstruction number, no experiment identity, no candidate number, no phase indication).
evaluator_blinding_manifest.per_candidate_fresh_evaluator_session_re: Per v3 item 8 (carried into v4): each candidate gets a fresh independent evaluator session. No evaluator session is told 'this is Phase 2' or 'control' or 'Phase 3' or any cue from which staged arm identity could be inferred. The operator-only blind map (see protocol §6) is the only place where blinded IDs are de-blinded; evaluators never see it.
evaluator_returns: Per-candidate raw M scores only: M1_pass, M2_pass, M3_pass, M4_pass, modification_conformance, candidate_all_pass.
evaluator_does_NOT_return: No aggregate computation (no G_mod_a, no G_mod_b, no G_mod_c, no G_mod_d).
evaluator_blinding_manifest.de_blinding_table: results/de-blinding-table.json (auditable; constructed post-scoring from runs/<R>/<B>/<arm>/<candidate> mapping) -- produced at the end of Phase 4 from the operator-only blind map (see protocol §6).
